_note: The 31-Aug-2026 checklist shown in the admin panel (Farmer Locator page, bottom). Source of truth for the SEEDED tasks — edit this file to add/reword/remove one and the panel picks it up on the next load, no deploy and no migration (read live by mtime, same rule as lead_offers.json / buyers.json). The database stores only STATE: which task is ticked, plus any task the owner adds himself. That split is deliberate — tick state is keyed by the stable `id`, so rewording a title here never loses a tick, and deleting a task here never deletes the owner's own tasks. Ordering is the order in this file. `owner` is 'you' (only the owner can do it — a phone call, a decision, a signup) or 'code' (Claude can do it unattended); the point of the split is that at this stage almost every blocker is 'you', and no amount of building moves them. `critical:true` marks the handful that actually decide the 31 Aug test in docs/MARKET-AND-MONEY.md §8 — everything else is support. Progress % counts every task equally; the ring is a nudge, not a metric to optimise.

sections.title: The Test — one paying counterparty
sections.sub: Nothing else on this page decides 31 Aug. ₹500 counts; ₹0 does not.

tasks.title: Write the 60-second Hindi phone pitch
tasks.note: Who we are, how many farmers see the district page, what the listing gets him, ₹500/month. Write it once — you will say it 20 times.

tasks.title: Pick the seed district for the खरीदार directory
tasks.note: Needs both traffic and a personal contact. Data can tell us the first half; only you know the second. Open question §7.2.

tasks.title: Build a list of 20 traders / input dealers in that district
tasks.note: Name, mandi, phone. Mandi lists, local contacts, walking the market — anything. Supply side needs no farmers.

tasks.title: Actually call at least 10 of them — log who answered
tasks.note: This is the single step most likely to be skipped, and skipping it makes a failed test unreadable (§8.4).

tasks.title: Get 3 to accept a free verified listing
tasks.note: Free first. A live page with real numbers on it is what you sell the fourth one with.

tasks.title: Enter the verified dealers in buyers.json
tasks.note: active:true only after a real call — the blue tick is a claim we make. Today the file holds one active:false example, so the directory renders in zero districts.

tasks.title: Have a way to actually receive ₹500
tasks.note: UPI or bank account + whatever passes for a receipt. Sounds trivial; it is the thing that stalls the close.

tasks.title: Decide: registered entity before taking dealer money?
tasks.note: Affects invoicing and which affiliate networks will onboard us. Open question §7.3. A decision either way unblocks; indecision blocks both.

tasks.title: ★ ONE counterparty has paid real money
tasks.note: The test. One dealer at ₹500/month, or one solar/loan/insurance partner paying per lead. Tick this and the model is proven.

sections.title: Lead slots — turn ₹0 placeholders into revenue
sections.sub: leads.py is built and rendering. It points at government pages, so it earns nothing by construction.

tasks.title: Read the GA4 `lead_click` count for the last 30 days
tasks.note: Do this BEFORE negotiating. You cannot price a lead you have never counted, and 'X farmers clicked this last month' is the entire pitch.

tasks.title: Find 1 local solar / PM-KUSUM installer and agree a per-lead price
tasks.note: Highest ₹ per lead of the three — ₹1–5 lakh ticket. Direct deal, no network approval, no fulfilment on our side.

tasks.title: Switch the solar offer on in lead_offers.json
tasks.note: Currently active:false with no URL. One config change once a partner exists — no deploy needed.

tasks.title: Replace the KCC-loan link with a real partner
tasks.note: Today it points at myscheme.gov.in. Agri-NBFC or affiliate network (Jai Kisan / Samunnati / Agriwise class).

tasks.title: Replace the फसल बीमा link with a real partner
tasks.note: Today it points at pmfby.gov.in. Same shape as the loan slot.

tasks.title: Persist /go/<id> clicks to the database
tasks.note: Right now a click is a logger.info line plus a GA4 event. Render rotates logs, so the negotiating number lives in one place only.

tasks.title: Show leads-this-month in the admin panel
tasks.note: So the number is in front of you every time you open this page, instead of behind a GA4 report you have to remember to run.

sections.title: Build — the missing connective tissue
sections.sub: Small and mine to do. None of it substitutes for the calls above.

tasks.title: Public "अपनी दुकान लिस्ट करें" page + form
tasks.note: Dealer supply that arrives without a phone call. Does not replace the first 10 calls — nobody finds the form until the directory exists.

tasks.title: Wire the sell/buy appeal into the खरीदार page
tasks.note: CropAppeal already captures 'I have 40 quintals of wheat in Hardoi'. On the kharidar page that intent IS the product we sell to a dealer.

tasks.title: Add / edit dealers from admin instead of hand-editing buyers.json
tasks.note: Matters the day you are sitting in a mandi with a dealer saying yes, and hand-editing JSON is not an option.

tasks.title: Confirm a kharidar page enters the sitemap once its district has a live dealer
tasks.note: Empty districts render noindex on purpose. Verify the reverse also happens — a seeded district must become discoverable.

sections.title: Traffic — the 4× multiplier
sections.sub: 0.5% CTR on ~4,000 impressions/day wastes 3,980 of them daily. Every revenue model is traffic × rate.

tasks.title: Export GSC pages + queries, last 28 days, and hand it over
tasks.note: The API is still blocked, so this is manual. Everything else in this section is blocked on it.

tasks.title: Rewrite titles + descriptions on the top-20 impression / low-CTR pages
tasks.note: Pages that already rank. Pure snippet work — no new content, and it keeps paying while you are hands-off.

tasks.title: Re-check CTR 14 days after the rewrite
tasks.note: Without the re-check this is a guess, not a change. Compare against the 0.5% baseline of 2026-07-23.

tasks.title: Unblock GSC API access
tasks.note: So CTR tracking stops being a manual export and can run unattended, per the everything-must-be-automatic rule.

sections.title: Keep it alive — the silent killers
sections.sub: Failures here are invisible from the outside: the site looks perfectly healthy while nothing works.

tasks.title: Settle the Neon migration / upgrade
tasks.note: A read-only compute serves every page fine and fails every write with a 500 — including ticking these boxes, dealer rows and lead logs. Every task on this page stores something.

tasks.title: Confirm the daily mandi fetch + archive fallback ran in the last 24h
tasks.note: The price tree is the traffic engine. Stale prices lose the ranking that everything else is built on.

tasks.title: Confirm the uptime / freshness alert actually reaches you
tasks.note: An alert nobody receives is worse than no alert — it buys false confidence during the hands-off weeks.

tasks.title: Every Monday: write down clicks/day, lead clicks, calls made
tasks.note: Three numbers, one line. On 31 Aug this is what tells you whether the test failed because the market said no, or because the calls never happened (§8.4).
